entities.summary: The World Islamic Science & Education University  is an Islamic university in Amman, Jordan that was established in 2008. The university is the permanent seat of the Arabic Language and Nation Identity Conference. It is accredited by the Jordanian Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research.
